title: Linguistics experts decipher what a Kansas accent is or is not
summary_en: In a new article, Lacey Wade and Jeff Holliday, assistant professors of linguistics at the University of Kansas, reveal that Kansans associate Kansas speech with “unaccentedness,” while non-Kansans associate Kansas speech with Southern-accented voices.
title_cn: Linguistics experts decipher what a Kansas accent is or is not

title: Authors shed light on first-generation experience for higher ed professionals
summary_en: A book chapter co-written by University of Kansas researcher Dallas Doane documents the experiences of first-generation higher education professionals who transition to faculty roles while highlighting the strengths people in the experience naturally bring.
title_cn: Authors shed light on first-generation experience for higher ed professionals

title: 15 instructional faculty members promoted in past year
summary_en: Fifteen individuals at the University of Kansas Lawrence and Edwards campuses have earned instructional faculty promotions over the past year. “These educators represent some of the best in teaching and research excellence,” said Arash Mafi, chief academic officer, provost and executive vice chancellor.
title_cn: 15 instructional faculty members promoted in past year
